title: Mobility’s impact on COVID-19 cases in ASEAN: a panel data regression study
core_idea: Analyze the impact of community mobility on daily COVID-19 cases in ASEAN countries by applying panel data regression to Google Mobility and WHO COVID-19 data (15 Feb 2020–13 Oct 2022), comparing three periods: pre-vaccination, vaccination rollout, and post-herd immunity.
tldr: Use panel regression on mobility and WHO case data to evaluate how community movement related to COVID-19 case trends across three pandemic periods in ASEAN.
